title: Tenma Tsukasa — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now all that's left is a handkerchief, and a hat as well, just in case.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There... That's just about everything I can think of.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Tomorrow is the day of the surprise tour Emu and the others planned for me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But as I have no idea of our destination, I don't know what I ought to bring.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, yes, they did instruct me on what to wear. Let me review Emu's message...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Message
rows.Line: <Tsukasa! Wear clothes that are easy to move around in tomorrow, 'kay? And maybe bring a lot of drinks, too☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Clothing that's easy to move in, and drinks... Are we exercising, perhaps?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, as Rui said, I suppose I'll find out when I get there. Now, exercise clothes... I believe they're in...
<Tsukasa☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Here we go, everyone☆ One, two, three!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Tsukasa!>

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh! Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I suppose the date changed over when I wasn't looking.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That's right! We decided to come say happy birthday the very first second!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We're the first ones to say it, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed you are! And a fine start to my birthday it's made!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe, I'm glad to hear it. It sounds like our surprise worked.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Definitely.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Were you getting ready for tomorrow, Tsukasa?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right. I had just finished, in fact.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The only thing left to do is to meet up with the others tomorrow and enjoy the day to its fullest!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehehe. It's exciting not knowing where you're going, huh☆>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You'll be coming here in the evening, right? I hope you're looking forward to our party, too!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! As soon as the tour is over, we'll come to you.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Are you awake?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am indeed!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry to bug you so late. There's something I wanna give you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Happy birthday, Tsukasa! Here's your present, from me♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see... A hand towel!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It's warm and soft and fluffy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope it'll be soothing for you even during your most intense training sessions!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oooh. It certainly is warm and fluffy...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I can already tell this towel will soothe me every time I wipe my sweat. Thank you, Saki! I'll use it gladly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, you have your surprise tour tomorrow, right? Have lots of fun with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You know I will! And it seems we'll be engaging in physical activity, so I'll bring this towel along as well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... If you're going to bring a towel, maybe a slightly bigger one would be better?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, uh, never mind!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll be a great day! Good night, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-Right... Sleep well!
The next day
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aah! Not a cloud in the sky, and a pleasant breeze!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is...the perfect weather for a tooour!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The perfect weather!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're even more energetic than usual this morning, Tsukasa. I suppose you are the guest of honor, after all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I received birthday wishes from Miku and the others, and a wonderful present from Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And having received a kind message from Toya this morning as well, I'm charged to the max with celebration power!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Celebration power?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. And what's more, Toya's message was not only a text, but a voice message...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And what's even more! That message was not only from Toya, but from everyone in Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The four of them even sang me a birthday song at the end!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, well. That's quite a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Even in a distant land, they're thinking of me... It truly warms my heart.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Unfortunately, their message arrived just as I was leaving the house, so I could only send a brief reply...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I intend to send them a song of thanks myself soon! And given the recipients, it will have to be an impressive one!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh, so it's a reverse surprise☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think just saying thank you would do the job...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll have to make our surprise tour equally as fulfilling, won't we?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, I guess so.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, everyone! It's time for the Make Tsukasa Super Duper Happy Smiley Tour to begin☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! As of today, you'll find me a changed man! Be it deep oceans or tall mountains, bring it on!
